summary: Independent attack found a mechanism-correctness defect in frontier-pressure liveness attribution. buildSnapshotFromRepo indexes latest heartbeat by worker_id only, so a heartbeat from a worker's later job can keep an older unrelated pin/claim falsely ACTIVE and suppress recovery/frontier pressure. A deterministic Node canary reproduces ACTIVE where job-scoped attribution requires REPLACEABLE, and existing tests lack this case. A bounded repair successor was materialized. Full whole-repository CLI replay at the pinned commit remains unexecuted in the local container because direct GitHub archive/clone network access is unavailable; exact persisted source/test bytes were inspected through the repository connector instead.
tests: scenario: old job-A pin + recent job-B heartbeat from same worker => current association ACTIVE; expected job-scoped liveness REPLACEABLE
unresolved: Whole-repository live snapshot CLI replay remains unexecuted in this worker because the local execution container cannot clone/download GitHub repository archives.
The source repair and regression suite are delegated to portfolio-frontier-pressure-job-scoped-heartbeat-fix-v1.
